name: What should I ask before hiring a garage conversion contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions help me tell whether a contractor really understands ADU garage conversions in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?
mainEntity.text: What questions help me tell whether a contractor really understands ADU garage conversions in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best contractor questions focus on experience, process, and risk management. Ask how many garage conversions they have completed locally, which cities they work in most often, and how they handle plan check comments, utility upgrades, slab issues, and inspections. A qualified team should be able to explain the difference between a quick cosmetic remodel and a true ADU conversion. They should also describe who prepares the drawings, who manages permits, and how change orders are handled when hidden conditions appear. Good contractors talk about feasibility first, not just finishes. Ask for examples of similar projects, realistic timelines, and what is included in the estimate. If the answers are vague, overly optimistic, or focused only on price, that is a warning sign. The right contractor should make the process feel predictable, not mysterious.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about local permit experience, utility coordination, structural upgrades, timeline realism, and how the contractor handles hidden conditions. A contractor who has completed similar garage conversions should be able to explain feasibility, approvals, and cost risks in plain language.
